note: CHANGE-ME: six common example ministries and two bookable facilities for the fictional Grace Community Church. Replace the names, scriptures, and descriptions with your church's real ministries — in their own words, not these. The two bookable facilities power the reservation feature; their ids deliberately match data/rentals.json so one double-booking check covers member reservations AND outside rentals. Edit and push to update; see docs/MANAGE.md.

ministries.name: Children's Ministry
ministries.scripture: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it. — Proverbs 22:6
ministries.description: Sunday-morning classes and monthly events where kids learn God's Word through age-appropriate lessons, crafts, and a lot of joy. Replace this with your children's ministry's own mission statement.

ministries.name: Youth Ministry
ministries.scripture: Don't let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example for the believers. — 1 Timothy 4:12
ministries.description: A safe, honest place for teenagers to ask real questions, build real friendships, and grow a faith of their own. Replace this with your youth ministry's own mission statement.

ministries.name: Women's Ministry
ministries.scripture: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come. — Proverbs 31:25
ministries.description: Bible study, prayer, and friendship that carries through the week — for women of every age and season. Replace this with your women's ministry's own mission statement.

ministries.name: Men's Ministry
ministries.scripture: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another. — Proverbs 27:17
ministries.description: Breakfasts, Bible study, and shoulder-to-shoulder service projects — men building each other up for the daily demands of work, family, and faith. Replace this with your men's ministry's own mission statement.

ministries.description: The choir, musicians, and worship team who lead us in praise every Sunday — rehearsals weekly, new voices always welcome. Replace this with your music ministry's own mission statement.
